text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner! With the roar of 
the crowd thundering, they enter the 
straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win!!! Haaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Take this...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Gimme a break—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (SEIYAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac pulls ahead!! Lucky Lilac 
takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Lala...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac crosses the line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A single flower blooms in Kyoto!! It's 
Lucky Lilac!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Lucky Lilac did it! 
Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That race was absolutely incredible……! 
Lucky Lilac and Almond Eye, I can't wait 
to see what comes next……!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... gh... Ha... 
wheeze...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No good... I've hit my limit... My whole 
body's on the verge of breaking down... 
but—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (How's that... Didja see that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (It's my complete victory...!!)
Damn it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I lost...! Even after all that summer 
training...!! Even after pouring 
everything into it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...A total defeat. But... not yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...No way—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Lala. Your running today 
was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As intensely frustrated as I feel, I was 
shivering just as hard with excitement...! 
My heart is still pounding even now...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will definitely challenge 
you again!! Until I defeat you!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Why are your eyes sparkling like 
that...ya?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (You don't think that at all, do you...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ("You can't beat Lala," they said...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I definitely surpassed my own 
limits. It really was the best run I 
could've given.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It was such a satisfying race that no one 
could blame them for thinking it was my 
peak. ...And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You're already planning to surpass it. 
You're convinced that you can.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Where's all that confidence coming 
from...?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Lala?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san, thanks for today. I 
reckon it's about time for me to head out.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I've got people waiting on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! I'm so sorry for keeping 
you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, see you at the next race! I'll be 
looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right. ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Switch gears. Now is not the time to 
be feeling like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Right now is the time to celebrate with 
all our might together...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)
choice_data_list: Luck...! You bloomed in full glory...!
Luck...! You bloomed in full glory...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...This is the flower you helped bloom. 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I will never forget her heroic figure, 
and I will wear it with pride from here on 
out."
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me be your partner.

Thank you for allowing me to be your 
partner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Now, shall we hold our heads high 
before everyone?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Our victory today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac brilliantly won the 
Shuka Sho, and we celebrated that glory 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're really running in the Japan 
Cup for your next race, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The victory I couldn't claim in the 
Shuka Sho— I will definitely seize it 
here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class members who have declared 
their entry are an exceptionally 
prestigious and formidable lineup. What 
are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It was precisely with that feeling in 
mind that I decided to enter the race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will win the Japan Cup against an 
amazing field and prove that I am the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘This announcement from Almond Eye 
quickly spread among race fans, pushing 
anticipation for the Japan Cup to its 
absolute peak—’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: What should we do about the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
I was thinking I wanted to race with 
Almond Eye

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The matchless rival I fought alongside all 
throughout the Triple Tiara. That is 
Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a rival like that running in the 
Japan Cup, Lucky Lilac must have mixed 
feelings about it. However—
choice_data_list:
If you want to run, it'll require some 
tough conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac was far more exhausted 
from the recent 'Shuka Sho' than we had 
imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering a grueling race like the Japan 
Cup, where so many powerhouses gather, 
means risks are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, what matters most is how Lucky 
Lilac feels."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wishes to run, then as her Trainer, 
it's my duty to dedicate everything to 
making that wish come true.
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will pass on it. The Japan 
Cup, that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, Trainer, I still have 
lingering fatigue from the Shuka Sho, and 
on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…………There will be more chances for me to 
run with Ai-san in the future, after all.
choice_data_list:
Okay, then let's pick a different goal 
race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As of right now, a prime candidate for our 
target race is the Nakayama Kinen—a 1800m 
turf GII held at Nakayama Racecourse next 
February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a traditional race where Senior Class 
Umamusume often run to test their mettle 
with an eye on the big races from spring 
onwards.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The Nakayama Kinen, huh? ...Sounds good. 
By that time, everything should be fully 
back in top shape."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Nakayama Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided to kick off the 
Senior Class with the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (This is no good...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When I decided not to run in the Japan 
Cup today... Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I felt relieved. ...Relieved that I 
didn't have to race against Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is sooo lame~~~~............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ya won the 'Shuka Sho' fair and square, 
didn't ya? Just take pride in that...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: And yet, why can't I... do that—
